items.model: Jenkinsfile DevSecOps Source & Admission直接sh；Jenkinsfile.security-audit调用原Manager生产adapter Secret Source；本轮父命令仅node infra/security/source-gate.mjs，不扩大为联合业务阶段
node:fs/crypto/net/os/child_process + synthetic-credential.mjs；独立inline runtime；不调用共享scanner-runtime.mjs
创建.devsecops，读取tools-lock.gitleaks，读取外层Lease并核对HEAVY_HOLDER或jenkins-petclinic-${BUILD_NUMBER}，git rev-parse HEAD；此处错误在try前失败
当前checkout/CWD的git archive --format=tar HEAD，128MiB archive上限，kubectl exec tar输入/work/source；不扫描本地主机或读取真实凭据
无独立version/manifest/verifyTools前置；使用tools-lock固定image并检查实际imageID包含其digest；通过真正Gitleaks命令结果观察工具不可用
gitleaks dir <path> --redact=100 --no-banner --log-level error --report-format json --report-path <file>；positive/clean/source三次扫描
没有显式--config；现有Gitleaks默认工具规则与reviewed-false-positives.json.entries路径/rule/精确源行SHA审查
Pod内/work/positive.json、/work/clean.json、/work/source.json；workspace .devsecops/gitleaks-native.json与source-gate.json
scan允许0/1；1不自动阻断父Gate；positive必须exit1且github-pat，clean必须exit0且0 findings；source按现有review loop决定；其他exit/error/timeout抛错
JSON.parse(String(cat.stdout)||[])再.map；source空bytes会变空数组；空白/损坏JSON/null/object通常导致现有失败；缺报告cat失败
原path去/work/source/前缀与..拒绝、精确源行SHA、rule/path匹配；新adapter复用未改的gitleaksEvidence，不实现第二分类器
独立source父Gate正常退出PASS，throw/非零FAIL；无WARN分支；生产Manager只enforce，exit10同样FAIL
kubectl cat非0即run抛错，不能视为空report；缺成功native receipt的Policy输入明确NOT_TESTED/null
实际JSON.parse/.map/审查循环错误由原catch/finally传播；不追加schema或severity规则
exec127或spawn error原run拒绝；无NOT_CONFIGURED fallback
普通run默认30s；Ready190s；exec90s；delete55s；helper遇r.error或意外status失败；Jenkins联合stage另有10min外层timeout
mkdir/read/write权限错误按当前位置在try前失败或catch/finally传播；不降级为PASS
create后初次source-gate写入、source native写入、finally最终source-gate写入；任一失败可令父进程失败，即使scanner已成功
finally关闭canary；有uid时read Pod并核对uid、正常delete等待、get ignore-not-found确认；替换/删除/读回/最终write失败会FAIL；无uid原实现跳过，不增加新规则
原节点进程exit传播到Jenkins sh；原Manager单选gitleaks计划重放，保留credentials/stage/sh/write/archive异常与非零失败，未执行Summary脚本或Jenkins CPS
